intro: Tammra Windfield is a tauren resident of Sun Rock Retreat, nestled within the heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. Deeply attuned to the balance of the land, she guides Horde travelers in honoring the natural cycle of renewal and keeping hope alive amid the peaks. Her concerns lie with both the health of the untamed wilderness and the safety of her kin.

p: Sun Rock Retreat serves as a vital sanctuary for the Horde within the craggy peaks of Stonetalon, surrounded by hostile harpies, Venture Company loggers, and lurking predators. Tammra Windfield stands among the settlement's caretakers, keeping a watchful eye on both the mountain wilderness and travelers who cross its threshold. Her gentle demeanor belies the resolve necessary to maintain a home in such rugged terrain.

Like many of her people, Tammra honors the Earth Mother by observing the constant rhythm of growth and decay in nature. Through the tasks she entrusts to travelers—such as tending the cycle of rebirth and bringing forth new life—she works to counter the ravages that conflict and exploitation bring upon Stonetalon. To Tammra, protecting the land requires active healing, ensuring that life flourishes even in scarred mountain soil.

Beyond her spiritual duties to the surrounding wild, Tammra bears deep concern for the companions and kin who brave the treacherous trails of the Stonetalon Mountains. When word spreads that travelers or family have vanished along the crags, she is among the first to seek out reliable aid. For Tammra, the endurance of Sun Rock Retreat depends as much on mutual protection and loyalty as it does on harmony with nature.
